title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. The page continues a combinatorial set-up for the 'structure at infinity' of the compactified moduli spaces M̂_{g,ν}, i.e. the Deligne–Mumford boundary. Grothendieck works with MD-graphs, which are dual graphs of stable marked curves. The previous page defines generisation morphisms G' → G: G is obtained from G' by contracting a set C' of edges. For a fixed G', generisations correspond to subsets of the edge set A', so there are 2^{μ'} of them. The 'écart' δ = card C' is the number of contracted edges. It ranges from 0 to the modular codimension of G' and is 0 exactly for isomorphisms.

(1) Factorisation. Every generisation morphism factors as a composite of generisations of écart 1 (single-edge contractions). Up to isomorphism, the number of such factorisations is δ!. These are the maximal chains in the Boolean lattice of subsets of C', i.e. the orderings of the contracted edges. The first, crossed-out claim 'de façon unique' was corrected to 'le nb de façons ... est égal à δ!'.

(2) Boundary strata. Fix an MD-graph G of anonymous type (g,ν). He considers two objects.
- (57): the closed stratum M̂_[G] ⊂ M̂_{g,ν}, proper over S, with unordered marked points.
- (58)/(59): its ordered-points version (M̂_G, Γ^!) → M̂_{g,I}. Here Γ^! = Ker(Aut G → S_I) is the group of automorphisms of G fixing the marked points. In modern terms this is the gluing map ∏_v M̄_{g_v,n_v} → M̄_{g,n} followed by the quotient by the leg-fixing automorphisms.

(3) Claim. The 2^M generisations of G (M = number of edges) correspond bijectively to the closed substacks M̂_[G'] (resp. (M̂_{G'}, Γ'^!)) that contain M̂_[G]. He calls these closed, proper and smooth over Z.

The next page states the point of this: it is the typical situation of a normal-crossings structure at infinity. That is checked by a local analysis via formal modular schemes, i.e. deformation theory of nodal curves, where the M nodes give M transversal boundary branches. Together, the page sets up the combinatorics (Boolean lattice of edge subsets ↔ local boundary strata) underlying the normal-crossings property of the DM boundary.
errors: The global bijection 'generisations of G ↔ strata M̂_[G'] containing M̂_[G]' fails in general. Contracting different edge subsets can give isomorphic graphs, hence the same stratum. Example: a vertex with two loops; contracting either loop gives the same stratum. The bijection holds only locally, for branches of the boundary at a general point of M̂_[G]. That is in fact what the normal-crossings statement on the next page needs.

The boundary of M̄_{g,n} is normal crossings but not simple normal crossings; e.g. Δ_irr self-intersects. So the closed strata M̂_[G'] are in general neither smooth nor normal, and 'inclusion' (M̂_G, Γ^!) ↪ M̂_{g,I} is not an immersion. Only the normalisation [∏M̄_{g_v,n_v}/Aut] is smooth. Calling the strata 'fermées ... lisses sur Z' is correct only for these normalisations or locally (branch by branch).

Minor: the δ! count is right if factorisations are counted as chains of edge subsets. If the source graph has automorphisms, 'up to isomorphism' needs care. With the morphism fixed, intermediate isomorphisms are rigid, so the count stands.

ideas.what: Factorisation of a generisation (edge-contraction) morphism of stable graphs into single-edge contractions, with δ! factorisations
ideas.modern_name: Maximal chains in the Boolean lattice of contracted edges; morphisms in the category of stable graphs generated by single contractions
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore; graph categories of Getzler–Kapranov (modular operads, 1998)

ideas.what: Boundary strata of M̄_{g,ν} indexed by dual graphs, with ordered-point version via the leg-fixing automorphism group Γ^! = Ker(Aut G → S_I)
ideas.modern_name: Stratification of M̄_{g,n} by stable graphs; gluing maps ξ_Γ: ∏M̄_{g_v,n_v} → M̄_{g,n} with image [M̄_Γ/Aut Γ]
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne–Mumford (1969), Knudsen (1983); systematised in Getzler–Kapranov and later Graber–Pandharipande-style tautological-ring work
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions the stratification/structure at infinity of M_{g,ν} in passing, without details

ideas.what: Correspondence between the 2^M generisations of G and the local boundary strata through M̂_[G], leading to the normal-crossings structure at infinity
ideas.modern_name: Normal crossings boundary of M̄_{g,n}; local Boolean stratification by smoothing subsets of nodes

deep.surprise_reason: This is standard combinatorics of the DM boundary stratification (edge contractions, δ! chains, strata indexed by stable graphs, normal crossings), all classical. The only notable features are minor imprecisions: the global vs. local bijection, and smoothness of the strata.
transcription_corrections: Line 3: 'de façon unique' is struck out and replaced by the interlinear insertion 'le nb de', giving 'le nb de façons de factoriser ainsi'.
Under (58) the struck-out underbrace label appears to be M̂^!_G.
In (59) a stray struck 'g' precedes 'u ∈ Γ'.
